name: Embraer E170/E175
summary: The most numerous US regional jet, flown at 76 seats by Republic, SkyWest, Envoy, Horizon and others.

wings: Low swept wing with canted winglets (larger on newer enhanced versions)
engines: Two CF34-8E turbofans under the wings
fuselage: 4-abreast 'double-bubble' fuselage, taller than it is wide
Rounded nose with a large four-pane windshield
tail: Tall swept fin with a dorsal fillet

tellTales: Small airliner with engines under the wings and winglets
Large four-pane windshield on a rounded nose
Low-set tail on a short 4-abreast body

confusedWith.howToTell: The E175 has engines under the wings and a low tail; the CRJ700/900 has rear-mounted engines and a T-tail.
The E175 has small engines and winglets; the A220 has huge geared-fan engines, plain wingtips and a wider body.
The E175 has underwing engines and a low tail; the ERJ145 has rear engines, a T-tail and a pencil-thin body.
The E190/E195 is longer with a larger wing and engines; the E175 is shorter and smaller.
